# Retrieval-Augmented Generation {#sec-rag}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.** Port and generalize from the CME 295-based
RAG workshop deck; keep the architecture cloud-agnostic in the main text,
with cloud specifics in callouts.
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- explain why retrieval beats ever-longer prompts for knowledge-intensive tasks [@lewis2020rag];
- design the canonical pipeline: chunk → embed → index → retrieve → rerank → generate;
- choose chunking and retrieval parameters with eyes open;
- name RAG's characteristic failure modes and the countermeasure for each.
